abyss-ink.$description: Abyss Ink — Page canvas, hero background, section backgrounds — the base surface every other color sits on

deep-slate.$description: Deep Slate — Elevated surfaces, card backgrounds, subtle surface lift from the canvas

frost-white.$description: Frost White — Primary headline text, logo wordmark, highest-emphasis content

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Body text, secondary headlines, hairline borders, divider lines — the workhorse neutral that draws the structural lines of the page

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Tertiary text, muted sub-headlines, nav secondary items, icon fills at rest

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card body text, secondary paragraph copy, low-emphasis content

steel-border.$description: Steel Border — Outlined button borders, ghost control frames, subtle elevated dividers

pale-mist.$description: Pale Mist — Micro-copy, fine-print detail, rare light text accents

ember-glow.$description: Ember Glow — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

ember-border.$description: Ember Border — Deep red border tone for warm-bordered emphasis elements and the underside of the gradient wave

signal-green.$description: Signal Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

inter.$description: The sole display and body typeface. Weight 300 on hero and section headlines whispers rather than shouts — institutional confidence through restraint. Weight 400 for body, 500 for navigation, and 600 reserved for emphasized content. Negative letter-spacing (-0.025em) tightens display sizes while wide tracking (0.200–0.300em) on all-caps section labels gives them the cadence of architectural annotations.

abcsynt.$description: ABCSynt — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
